definitions.us_all: Every label FDA DailyMed lists as a sunscreen drug. Out of scope, with the reason recorded in the master: SPF makeup (BB/CC creams, foundations, cushions, concealers, makeup powders, and primers or setting products not named as sunscreens; scripts/scope_rules.py), SPF lip products, diaper creams, calamine, and zinc-oxide products with no sun claim. Tinted sunscreens and tinted moisturizers are sunscreens. Labels that left DailyMed stay, with status 'discontinued'. A label DailyMed failed to serve this week keeps its last fully read record (fetch_status 'carried_forward').
definitions.us_mineral: Labels whose declared actives include zinc oxide or titanium dioxide, adult and baby, hybrids included. filter_type gives the main filter by summed w/w % on the Drug Facts panel. Actives follow the printed Drug Facts where the FDA filing contradicts it (data/corrections/spl_label_errors.jsonl).
definitions.us_baby_kids: Baby and kids sunscreens: the reviewed decisions in claims/baby_decisions.csv (the population the arwhouse.com/evidence pages count), then, for labels not yet reviewed, the rule: the product name (not the labeler) or the label's front panel says baby, infant, toddler, kids, children, junior or little ones. Any filter type. baby_kids_basis says which.
